policy_metadata.policy_title: Laboratory – Testing for Diagnosis of Active or Latent Tuberculosis

sections.heading: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
content: As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) as outlined below. In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements. • An interferon gamma release assay (IGRA) (CPT code 86480, CPT code 86481) and an acid fast bacilli (AFB) smear or stain (CPT code 87116) ARE REIMBURSABLE to diagnose latent tuberculosis (TB) infection for individuals at risk for infection based on clinical presentation or risk factors noted below upon screening evaluation: ▪ Abnormal weight loss ▪ Acute kidney failure or chronic renal disease ▪ Cough ▪ Crohn's disease ▪ Diabetes mellitus ▪ Enlarged lymph nodes ▪ Human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) disease ▪ Immunodeficiency ▪ Lymphoma, leukemia or multiple myeloma ▪ Malignant neoplasm of head, face and neck ▪ Nonspecific reaction to cell mediated immunity measurement of gamma interferon antigen response ▪ Nonspecific reaction to tuberculin skin test without active tuberculosis ▪ Opioid or illicit substance use ▪ Pericardial effusion ▪ Pleural effusion ▪ Pulmonary nodule ▪ Rheumatoid arthritis ▪ Steroid or immunosuppressant use ▪ Transplanted organ and tissue status when screening is mandated • For individuals diagnosed with TB, nucleic acid testing for Mycobacterium (CPT code 87551, CPT code 87556, CPT code 87561) IS REIMBURSABLE. • For individuals with active tuberculosis, IGRA (CPT code 86480, CPT code 86481) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE . • Quantitative nucleic acid testing for Mycobacterium species (CPT code 87552), M. tuberculosis (CPT code 87557) and M. avium complex (CPT code 87562) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE . • Genotyping of Mycobacterium species (CPT code 87150, CPT code 87153) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE . • Adenosine deaminase (ADA) (CPT code 84311) levels in cerebrospinal, pleural, peritoneal, pericardial and other fluids for the diagnosis of extrapulmonary TB IS NOT REIMBURSABLE . • Tests designed to detect or diagnose TB through detection of serum biomarkers (CPT code 0574U) ARE NOT REIMBURSABLE.
